reviews.title: So necessary!!
reviews.text: *update* Please fix the lag/sluggishness. Sometimes when I add vocab words the app freezes or takes forever to load. Sometimes. I have to force close it……old review>>>This app is amazing. I wish I would have downloaded it sooner. Right now i’m at B2 level in Spanish. I completed Duolingo and use Preply for conversation. I’m currently in my second semester of studying Spanish in Mexico. I originally just downloaded this for a place to practice vocab flash cards. Then I saw the grammar lessons and stared to work on areas of weakness or solidify concepts. The grammar lessons are life changing. The videos and the amount of practice and content for each topic really helps me get the repetition down. Thank you so much for the app! I pay for the Pro and its definitely worth every penny. I really like that when i’m doing the flashcards you give an example of usage in a sentence. One thing I don’t like is the vosotros usage in the activities I don’t think i’m going to ever going to use it.

reviews.title: workflows/UX is thoughtless
reviews.text:
For example, what if I want to hear a spanish phrase pronounced? There is seemingly no way to do this except by speaking the phrases in english, hoping it gets translated into the spanish phrase I want to hear pronounced, and then clicking the speaker icon. Even when I go to the “pronunciation” UI, I can’t just input a Spanish phrase and hear it pronounced. I have to input it in English, hope it is translated to what i want to hear in spanish, and then tap the speaker icon.

And what if I want to reverse a translation to backtest the output? This is easy to do in the google translate app with a single tap, but in SpanishDict it requires copying the output, navigating to a different pane in the app, then pasting in the content and submitting it.

Also, the font is too small and there is no way to adjust it.
